back.body: FOUR NATIONAL LEVELS, each containing the one below · EMERGENCY MEDICAL RESPONDER: first on scene, basic life support, minimal kit · EMT: the backbone — assessment · airway · oxygen · ventilation · bleeding · splinting · childbirth · a short mostly-assisted medication list · ADVANCED EMT: adds some advanced airways, IV access, wider medication list · PARAMEDIC: widest — advanced airways, cardiac monitoring and interpretation, large medication list · THE LEVEL IS WHAT THEY ARE TRAINED AND LICENSED TO DO — not the vehicle, not the patch · YOUR STATE SETS YOUR SCOPE and it may be narrower · THE POINT: recognise when you need the level above you, AND CALL EARLY
back.why_it_matters: Eighteen minutes is eighteen minutes whether you ask at minute four or minute twenty.

front.title: EMS systems and medical direction
front.summary: The protocol IS the doctor's instruction

back.body: AN EMS SYSTEM IS A CHAIN, not a fleet: ACCESS → DISPATCH → FIRST RESPONSE → TRANSPORT → HOSPITAL → REHABILITATION · behind it: training, licensing, equipment, communications, funding · around it: QUALITY IMPROVEMENT, which changes what needs changing · It is only as good as its worst handover · YOU DO NOT PRACTISE ON YOUR OWN LICENCE — you practise under a PHYSICIAN MEDICAL DIRECTOR'S, delegated · OFFLINE = protocols and standing orders WRITTEN IN ADVANCE, covering most of what you do · ONLINE = a physician in REAL TIME · THE PROTOCOL IS THE DEFAULT ANSWER; THE CALL IS FOR WHAT IT DID NOT ANTICIPATE — and is not skipped when protocol says to make it
back.why_it_matters: He stood holding the mask asking whether to phone the doctor who had signed the order eighteen months earlier.

front.title: Roles and professionalism
front.summary: Yourself first, so the arithmetic works

back.body: PRIORITY ORDER: YOURSELF → CREW → PATIENT → BYSTANDERS · not callousness — AN INJURED EMT BECOMES A SECOND PATIENT and the ambulance coming for the first is now needed twice · CORE ROLE: assess · treat IN SCOPE · transport safely to the RIGHT place · hand over accurately with a record that matches · PROFESSIONALISM IS NOT UNIFORM — it is punctuality, confidentiality, how you speak to frightened people, and HOW YOU TALK ABOUT PATIENTS WHEN THEY CANNOT HEAR YOU · ADVOCACY only counts when it costs something: the paramedic that delays you, the trauma centre that is further · CONTINUING EDUCATION — out-of-date practice feels exactly as confident as current practice · They will remember whether you were kind
back.why_it_matters: He crossed a live carriageway because it felt unthinkable not to, and she waited longer for it.

back.body: QI = the system looking at WHAT IT ACTUALLY DID and changing what needs changing · IT RUNS ON YOUR PATIENT CARE REPORTS — a vague record makes the whole process BLIND, at a scale of thousands of calls · SYSTEMS RATHER THAN BLAME: ask what made the error POSSIBLE, not who made it — a process that catches a careful person at 4am will catch the next one · BLAME STOPS REPORTING, AND A SYSTEM WITH NO REPORTS CANNOT IMPROVE · EVIDENCE-BASED = used because it is SHOWN to work, not because it is traditional · ALREADY REVERSED: routine BACKBOARDING · universal HIGH-FLOW OXYGEN · TOURNIQUETS as a last resort · 'We have always done it this way' is a DESCRIPTION, not a justification · A PATIENT IMPROVING DOES NOT PROVE YOU HELPED — most patients improve
back.why_it_matters: Thousands of boarded patients doing well is what happens either way. That is why it took evidence.

back.body: EMS GOES WHERE NOTHING ELSE IN HEALTHCARE GOES — into homes, at night, unannounced · PREVENTION: car seats · smoke alarms · the rug at the top of the stairs · helmets — unglamorous, and it prevents more harm over a career than any single call · DATA: one call is a photograph, ten thousand are a MAP — the junction, the building, the postcode — but only if the reports were written well enough to see it · CREWS SEE EMERGING PROBLEMS FIRST — a new drug shows up in ambulances before anywhere official · FREQUENT CALLERS SIGNAL UNMET NEED, NOT MISUSE — answer with a REFERRAL, not a sigh; know what pathways your service has · SAFEGUARDING sits here: you may be the only professional who sees the house
back.why_it_matters: Nothing about her had been a misuse of anything. It had been a question nobody had answered.
